rule: This file records where shared English learning/runtime work should continue. It is not exam/source truth, not private learner state, and not a substitute for LEARNING_CONTRACT.md or module contracts. A fresh Chat must read the shared Learning Contract first, then the relevant module owner(s), before proposing new English work.
completed_shared_work: English Current consolidation completed: concise manifest, provenance separation, canonical exam/source assets, and Current-only Astro gating.

Global English LEARNING_CONTRACT.md is the common cross-module learning authority: ability formation before material/UI organization; Clean Attempt; first meaningful failure; smallest sufficient repair; reconstruction/re-execution; selective memory admission; later fresh transfer as stronger mastery evidence.
English capability architecture is frozen as four ability lines (Lexical / Reading / Translation / Writing) plus task-specific trainers rather than one equal system per exam section.
Objective Runtime v1 is frozen for Cloze / Reading A / Reading B at content/english/modules/objective-runtime.md.
Frozen objective review-unit rule: training evidence may be question/blank/placement-level, but learner-Chat review is passage/set-level. Evidence granularity may be smaller than Review granularity.

Objective passage/set Review Packet v1 is defined: complete unit identity + attempt summary + compact outcome map for every item + expanded content only for wrong/unanswered/uncertain items + whole-unit diagnosis before repair threads.
Objective state logic is frozen: ATTEMPT -> PASS or REPAIR_NEEDED -> ROOT_CAUSE (Lexical / Reading / task-specific) -> REPAIR -> TRANSFER_PENDING -> later unseen transfer -> CLOSED.
Wrong items do not automatically become long-term memory; same-item correction is weaker than later unseen transfer.
Cloze cognitive object is Slot Constraint -> Best Fit; it does not own a duplicate vocabulary system.
Reading A cognitive object remains understand -> locate decisive evidence -> adjudicate options -> execute.
Reading B / Part B cognitive object is Discourse Reconstruction and supports local, coupled, and structure-level repair with cascading errors merged under the primary cause.
Reading A module contract is aligned to the frozen passage-level Chat review rule. Question-level objects are internal evidence/repair slices only.

Reading A Astro now has a passage-level Chat handoff. The normal packet includes the passage once, an all-question compact outcome map, and expanded wrong/unanswered/uncertain question content. Legacy per-question copy-to-Chat controls are demoted/hidden in the normal flow.
Reading A continuous-session handoff remains a higher-level cross-passage review surface rather than replacing the minimum one-passage review unit.

Reading now inherits the KianOS shared learner-surface baseline explicitly: /reading/ is a Current lane home with private last-passage Continue plus Current passage navigation, while clean Attempt/Review/Transfer/Handoff remain owned by the existing passage runtime at /reading/<id>/.
Translation has a canonical module contract at content/english/modules/translation.md and inherits the shared Learning Contract.

Translation Runtime v1 is frozen in translation.md: learner-facing review is one complete Translation task/set while sentence/clause/relation/span remain internal evidence units; cascading downstream errors collapse under the earliest sufficient cause; repair requires learner reconstruction before full-reference comparison when possible; known-sentence correction remains repair evidence; closure requires later fresh/unseen transfer.

Writing currently inherits the shared Learning Contract directly; Writing A/B are output modes inside Writing, not separate base abilities. A Writing-specific module contract should be created only when its own cognitive/runtime baseline is actually frozen.
Module-specific cognition remains non-isomorphic: do not force one error taxonomy, review card, or UI shape across Reading, Translation, Writing, Cloze, and Part B.

KianOS SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md now applies the shared Current/Continue/Navigate/Repair/Verify/Handoff/Deferred/Validation baseline to independently entered English sub-lane runtimes as they are materialized; a module contract on paper is not enough to call that learner runtime Ready.
Canonical English exam source remains materialized and verified: 27 papers, 235 sets, 1364 questions/prompts; Reading corpus has 110 passages and 540 questions.

translation.inheritance: Translation inherits all shared English learning/evidence/mastery/memory/UI principles, then applies its own English-representation -> relation preservation -> information preservation -> Chinese reconstruction cognition and its frozen Translation Runtime v1. Objective Runtime does not redefine Translation cognition, review unit, or runtime state semantics. When Translation becomes learner-facing, it also inherits the KianOS shared learner-surface baseline from SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md without copying Reading UI.

writing.inheritance: Writing inherits all shared English learning/evidence/mastery/memory/UI principles. Writing A and Writing B are modes within one Writing ability line. Do not copy Reading/Cloze review mechanics into Writing merely for UI consistency. When a Writing learner runtime is materialized, it must also implement the KianOS shared learner-surface baseline in a Writing-appropriate form.
writing.current_owner_status: No Writing-specific module contract is frozen yet; the next Writing chat should derive and freeze it from the shared contract plus real Writing cognition.

objective_tasks.inheritance: Objective-task module contracts and Astro trainers may extend task-specific cognition/UI but must preserve the frozen passage/set-level learner review unit, Review Packet v1, root-cause routing, transfer-based closure semantics, and the KianOS shared learner-surface baseline when each trainer becomes independently learner-facing.

next_action.instruction: Continue objective-task implementation without reopening Objective Runtime v1. Build Cloze and Reading B from the frozen cognitive objects and passage/set Review Packet rules. Reuse shared infrastructure only where it preserves the task-specific learning action; do not clone Reading A UI mechanically. Each independently entered trainer must also inherit the KianOS shared learner-surface baseline (Current, Continue, Navigate, Repair, Verify/Transfer, Return/Handoff, Deferred, Validation) in a task-appropriate way.
cloze: Attempt unit is one complete Cloze passage/set.
Core action is Slot Demand -> active constraints -> competing candidates -> decisive constraint -> Best Fit.
Review packet keeps all blanks in a compact outcome map and expands only wrong/unanswered/uncertain blanks with minimum local context plus candidates while retaining whole-passage context.
Route sense/phrase/construction/collocation/confusable failures to LexicalOS; route representation/discourse failures to Reading; keep only true best-fit procedure failures in Cloze.
Do not create a permanent Cloze mistake bank or twenty independent review cards.
reading_b: Attempt unit is one complete Part B material/set.
Core action is discourse skeleton -> required role -> candidate role -> backward/forward/cohesion fit -> global reconciliation.
Review packet preserves the complete learner placement/matching map plus formal map and enough material/candidate inventory for reconstruction.
Diagnosis must support local, coupled, and structure-level repair, with cascading dependent errors attached to the primary structural error.
Do not reduce Part B to keyword matching or clone Reading A's question-by-question review UI.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not reopen English Objective Runtime v1 merely because a UI implementation is inconvenient or a source uses a different taxonomy.
Do not reopen Translation Runtime v1 merely to harmonize UI or taxonomy with objective tasks; reopen only when new learner evidence materially contradicts the frozen Translation model.
Do not turn Cloze / Reading A / Reading B into three independent knowledge systems.
Do not make the learner review objective questions one-by-one in Chat; passage/set is the minimum user-facing review unit.
Do not restore per-question copy-to-Chat as the normal Reading A bridge.

Do not make the learner review Translation sentence-by-sentence as separate Chat flows; one complete Translation task/set is the learner-facing review unit while smaller slices remain internal evidence.
Do not force one failure taxonomy or one review-card shape across all English modules.
Do not show formal answers, evidence, explanations, teacher methods, model translations, or model essays before a clean attempt.
Do not require annotation, quick-cause labels, or note-taking for every question.
Do not make stable-correct objective items enter full review by default.
Do not turn teacher-method material into the default learning path; it remains a repair reservoir.
Do not duplicate lexical knowledge inside Reading/Cloze/Part B/Translation/Writing when LexicalOS is the canonical owner.
Do not treat accuracy on remembered material as equivalent to unseen mastery.
Do not create more module/governance files merely for completeness; create a specific owner only when a genuine cognitive/runtime object has been defined and frozen.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at meaningful English shared-work stage transitions or when the next active module/action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, content/english/LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, and only the Current module owners needed for the active task. Objective work must additionally read objective-runtime.md. Reading A implementation work must also read reading-a.md. Translation must additionally read translation.md. Writing currently inherits LEARNING_CONTRACT.md until its own module contract is frozen. Continue from next_action rather than reconstructing the roadmap from prior chats.
